FINAL SITE LOG
Paid cash: two wheelbarrows from ToolTown, PHP 7,600. Our mason completed the stair nosing repair yesterday.

Estimate only: repaint lobby PHP 45,000. Alternative tile still under review. Install handrail next Monday. Waterproofing was cancelled. Pending delivery of sand.

Receiving copy checked by Liza. For closeout approval. Call Ben about the placeholder supplier.
